description: Verify transitions follow `FREE -> OPTION -> RESERVED -> SOLD` strictly. No skipped steps, no reverse transitions without explicit override.
Confirm all transitions are server-side only with actor and reason tracking persisted.
Check TTL expiry handling - temporary holds must have expiration timestamps and worker-driven expiry jobs.
Verify expiry actions revalidate current state before transitioning to avoid stale overwrites.
Verify booking actions use DB-level locks or serializable transaction isolation.
Check that offer acceptance is idempotent - repeated calls produce the same result.
Flag TOCTOU bugs: availability checked in one query, then booked in a separate query without lock.
Confirm parallel reservation requests for the same inventory return deterministic conflict responses.
Check that coupled acceptance and reservation writes happen within a single transaction boundary.
Verify published offer versions are immutable snapshots - no mutations after publish.
Check that client acceptance targets a specific version ID, not the latest mutable draft.
Flag any code path that modifies fields on a published or accepted offer version.
Confirm version creation produces a new row/record, not an in-place update.
Verify outbox pattern for external side effects - events persisted to DB before delivery.
Check that worker jobs have retry configuration and explicit failure/dead-letter handling.
Flag fire-and-forget calls to external systems (CRM, Slack, email) without persistence or retry.
Verify timeout and circuit-breaker configuration on external HTTP calls.

Same TanStack Query key array literal (e.g. ['suppliers'], ['media-units', id]) appearing in 2+ files. Query keys must be defined once in a query factory. Duplicates cause cache inconsistency when one call site changes the key shape but another does not.

Copying `useQuery` result data into `useState`. This creates a stale local copy that opts out of TanStack Query background refetches. Use query data directly, or use `select` to derive. Exception: form `defaultValues` with `staleTime: Infinity`.
Filters, pagination, or sort state stored in `useState` instead of TanStack Router URL search params. URL state is required for bookmarkability and correct back/forward navigation.
